title: Workflow in transgenic mice for the study of specific cancers associated with the post-menopausal state
protocol: Seed 8 × 10^3 LLC1 tumor cells into 96-well plates.
Incubate for 6 hours.
Remove spent medium from each well after treatments with steroids (Progesterone, Estradiol or Cholesterol [0–100 μM]).
Add 50 μL of 0.5 mg/mL MTT to cells.
Incubate for 1 hour.
Add 100 μL DMSO to cells to dissolve formazan crystals.
Incubate at 37°C for 3 hours.
Record the absorbance at 570 nm.
Cultivate cells in medium containing charcoal-treated FBS for 24 hours before initiating experiments.
After treatments, add 100 μL accutase to LLC1 tumor cells.
Incubate for 6 minutes for cell detachment.
Centrifuge cells at 100 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the pellet twice with cold PBS.
Reconstitute in 100 μL Annexin-V binding buffer.
Transfer the constituents to FACS tubes.
Add 5 μL PE-conjugated Annexin-V to the samples.
Incubate tubes in the dark for 15 min at 25°C.
Add 500 μL Annexin-V binding buffer to the incubated tubes.
Incubate for an additional 15 min.
Analyze samples by flow cytometry.
Use FlowJo software for data analysis to calculate the percentage of Annexin-V-positive cells.
Place sterile glass coverslips in 24-well plates.
Seed 2 × 10^4 LLC1 tumor cells per well and culture for 8 h.
Wash cells with cold PBS after treatments.
Add 200 μL Annexin-V binding buffer containing 7 μL FITC-conjugated Annexin-V and 4 μL propidium iodide to wells.
Incubate for 15 min in the dark.
Wash cells with cold Annexin-V binding buffer three times.
Use DPX as mountant.
Capture images on a fluorescence microscope with a 10× objective lens.
Anesthetize mice by an intraperitoneal injection of ketamine and xylazine in a ratio of 4:1, diluted with autoclaved water.
Determine the volume of the injection based on body-weight; three times the body-weight works best.
Gently press the footpad to ensure desensitization.
Shave the animal's dorsal side and disinfect the skin with 70% ethanol.
Make a single small incision and separate the musculature using curved-tipped scissors.
Carefully pull each ovarian fat pad out of the incision and gently excise the ovaries.
Close the surgical cut using 9 mm surgical clips.
Topically apply povidone-iodine solution 10% w/v.
Employ electrocauterization for real-time blood vessel ligation to minimize blood loss.
Add ibuprofen and paracetamol suspension (1 ml/100 ml) to the drinking water for 2 days.
Remove surgical clips after 10 days of surgery.
Assess serum prolactin levels to confirm the efficacy of the surgery.
Shave the dorsal side of the animal a day before tumor cell implantation.
Inspect the shaved area for absence of skin allergy or local inflammation.
Subcutaneously inject 40,000 LLC1 tumor cells suspended in serum-free DMEM on the dorsal side using a 26G needle.
Measure tumors that arise using a digital caliper.
Calculate tumor volumes using the modified ellipsoid formula: ½ (Length × Width²), where w is the smaller value of the two-perpendicular tumor axes.
